When reviewing any capture, look deliberately at the seams of the street: footway back edge against lot fronts, walls and
facades; carriageway against kerb; terrain against paving. A strip of grass/terrain between the footway and the lots is a
defect, even when the change under review did not cause it.

**Why:** 2026-11-09 I approved the pedestrian-traffic photos (`zebra_high`) without seeing a ~1 m grass strip between the
footway and every lot front; the owner caught it ("já mandei você analisar essas imagens com atenção").

**How to apply:** for each photo, name what is at each street seam before judging the change itself; report pre-existing
defects too and send them to the owning area. Related: [[delegate-port-with-trace]], [[coordinate-parallel-sessions]].
